skillTree.localised_description: Every army needs a warrior with a fire burning in their belly. Literally.
A sword of searing heat cuts through flesh as if tearing through a damp scroll.
Imbued with the divine favor of the Fire Mouth, this skill reduces hero action costs, boosts success rates, and shortens cooldowns for abilities unique to Firebellies.

skillTree.localised_description: Stumpy and short-witted as they are, these Gnoblars have an eye on the sky at all times.
It never hurts to keep your lucky Gnoblar with you, just in case.
Puny magicks are nothing in the face of the Great Maw's endless hunger.
A Bellower’s voice is as deep as it loud, carrying across the battlefield and encouraging unbridled carnage.
Having learned much in their long years of service, this character now turns their attention to training others.

skillTree.localised_description: Morg’s molten flesh gleams with a fiery sheen, a testament to his rebirth in the heart of the Fire Mouth. This glowing, magma-infused skin is both a symbol of his divine selection and an impenetrable defense forged by the Fire Mouth itself.

As the chosen voice of the Fire Mouth, Morg channels the deity’s will through fiery proclamations and devastating displays of power. His very presence inspires awe and dread, as flames dance around him in rhythmic harmony with his booming words.

skillTree.localised_description: Morg embodies the pure essence of fire, his every movement radiating intense heat and unrelenting power. Wherever he treads, flames erupt, consuming his enemies in a torrent of searing destruction.

skillTree.localised_description: As the divine champion of the Fire Mouth, Morg Magmaborn stands as a living embodiment of volcanic fury and unrelenting power. skillTree.localised_description: No enemy is immovable when in the path of a furious Ogre's charge.
This warrior is one with their blade; it is an extension of their will, making them a worthy foe in combat.
This Ogre's greed shall never be sated, for his stomach is as endless as his hunger.
A truly sturdy armour is needed to hold such an overflowing gut in place.
Such is their power and ferocity, a wound-maker will ravage the foe, cutting and pulverising until there is only one exit - death.
From one bloodied, lifeless corpse to the next, this one is always looking for the next adversary to best.

attributes.bullet_text: This unit frightens all enemy units, reducing their leadership when nearby. It is also immune to fear. Fear penalties do not stack.
This unit provides a leadership bonus to nearby allies. Units within range of both the Lord's aura and an encouraging unit will receive the larger of the two bonuses.
This unit can hide in forests until enemy units get too close.
When attacking braced charge defenders, this unit only loses half of its charge bonus
Allows the unit to attack and destroy walls in melee. This attribute also adds a  +50% damage multiplier against buildings.

backgroundSkills.localised_description: When the Ogres arrived at the impact site of the boulder the next day, they stumbled upon a very peculiar scene. Lying in a sizeable crater was the lonely boulder, cracked open through the force of the crash. And inside the hollow rock was an Ogre with red glowing skin, bearing the traditional markings and tattoos of a Firebelly. Thus began the new life and legend of Morg, the Magmaborn.
